summary: Verified Task T3 structured-output implementation, API contracts, Mermaid fail-closed behavior, and SSE regression coverage.
final_report: FAIL. The implementation is broadly verified but one concrete failure remains: app/services/mermaid.py catches built-in TimeoutError but not subprocess.TimeoutExpired. A controlled edge probe patching _run_adapter to raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired propagated that exception instead of returning ModelOutputError with issue_codes=[mermaid_validator_unavailable]. This violates the requested Mermaid unavailable/failure behavior for a real subprocess timeout. No source files were modified by Merlin. The incomplete node_modules Mermaid install means live valid-diagram parsing could not be exercised; the existing unavailable fail-closed path was exercised and returned the expected ModelOutputError. TASK STATUS: T4 → failed

findings.evidence: python -m pytest tests/test_api_chat_sse.py tests/test_structured_outputs.py tests/test_api_outputs.py tests/test_mermaid.py -q -> 25 passed in 3.70s

node --check tools/validate_mermaid.mjs passed; node v22.15.1 and npm 11.4.0 available. python -m compileall -q app tests reached app/services/mermaid.py but failed replacing a temporary pyc with WinError 5 on the UNC/SMB workspace. This environment failure is recorded in oc-issues.txt entries 29-30. Focused py_compile was not claimed as a pass after this compileall failure.

Generated FastAPI OpenAPI for POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/outputs contains a response oneOf for ChatOutputEnvelope, MermaidOutputEnvelope, TodoOutputEnvelope, and QuizOutputEnvelope with discriminator propertyName=kind and complete mapping.

BOM and one JSON fence accepted; trailing object/data rejected with trailing_data; fenced JSON with trailing data rejected; existing tests verified one bounded repair attempt and retryable exhaustion.

Strict request probes rejected boolean count, integer prompt coercion, unknown request fields, and count=0. API probes returned 422 for quiz count mismatch and unknown/extra request fields. A two-question quiz returned positions [0, 1]. Existing tests verified duplicate options and invalid indexes.
POST output for missing session returned 404 not_found. Existing SSE tests verified missing configuration returns 400 config_error.

Unsafe directive %%{ was rejected with mermaid_unsafe_source; oversized and script sources are covered by tests. Incomplete node_modules caused a live adapter import failure, which correctly returned mermaid_validator_unavailable. A controlled _run_adapter subprocess.TimeoutExpired raised uncaught TimeoutExpired instead of ModelOutputError mermaid_validator_unavailable.

The full existing SSE/chat tests ran as part of the focused set and full suite; event sequence, citations, partial persistence, retry, duplicate replay, strict insufficiency, grounded empty context, missing session, config, and CRUD checks passed.

blockers: Production fix required in app/services/mermaid.py to catch subprocess.TimeoutExpired (or its appropriate superclass) and convert it to fail-closed ModelOutputError before approval.

Live Mermaid syntax validation remains environment-blocked by the incomplete node_modules tree from the prior npm timeout; a clean dependency install is needed for full valid/invalid adapter execution.
